title: Echelon Integration Execution Envelope v2
description: Carries an integration invocation across a system boundary (spec/provenance-propagation.md, REG-PROV-004..REG-PROV-008). Identity semantics are owned by Praxis (RQ-ROS-2026-A013..A019, DF-ROS-2026-A037): `actor` is a Praxis provenance actor and `provenance` a Praxis interchange block, referenced from the unchanged vendored Praxis schemas in schemas/vendor/praxis/. The registry defines routing and transport fields only. This schema is the structural floor; the full receiving verdicts (supported/unsupported/malformed, credential tripwire, at-most-one-created) are defined by the Praxis conformance fixtures and the reference classifier.

operationId.description: Idempotency key of the invocation. Replaying the same operationId MUST NOT duplicate domain records or contributions (REG-PROV-010).

actor.description: The CURRENT invoking actor, as a Praxis provenance actor. Never the originator of the carried payload unless it is the same actor (REG-PROV-009).

execution.description: The execution the invoking actor is running in: a Praxis execution (EXE-...) or another Echelon system's execution (EXT-<system>.<run-id>). Absent means unknown; receivers then key the invoker's contribution EXT-op.<operationId> (REG-PROV-006). Never fabricated.

source.description: Source repository/branch/commit/work item, unchanged from v1.

provenance.description: Praxis interchange block describing the payload being carried. A praxis.provenance/1 block (or an untagged block, read as major 1) must meet the Praxis structural floor; a block of another praxis.provenance major is carried verbatim and is only required to be tagged (REG-PROV-007).
